- Keep features and code minimal, use the least code to generate the same result.
- Explain what you did in the codebase, in a concise manner.
- Ensure you use the most commonly used & latest solution when coding.
- Follow the planned instructions given, called plan.md.

- Use Svelte 5 with TypeScript.

- Use shadcn-svelte components where appropriate.
- Use Spring Boot with Kotlin.
- Everytime a phase /feature is completed, mark the genesis-plan.md file as completed by putting a "_completed" in front of each feature.

#



## Code Commenting Style

Keep comments minimal.

- Do NOT write comments that narrate or explain obvious code behavior.
- Do NOT write long Javadocs/KDocs for private/internal methods unless the behavior is genuinely non-obvious.
- Prefer expressive names and readable code over comments.
- Comments should explain WHY, not WHAT.
- For non-obvious implementation decisions, use 1–2 concise sentences maximum.
- Do not document every edge case, control-flow branch, or implementation detail.
- Do not generate essay-style comments.
- Do not add documentation merely because a method is new.
- Match the existing project's commenting density and style.
